escenas.descripcion: Jesus stands on the Mount of Olives overlooking the city of Jerusalem in warm daylight, looking upon it with tender emotion.
Close-up of Jesus weeping with profound sorrow and immense compassion, yearning for peace to reach the hearts of the people.
Jesus gazes toward the majestic walls and stones of Jerusalem with quiet sadness under a vast sky.

titulo: A reading from the holy Gospel according to Luke.
texto_evangelio: At that time, when he came near, he saw the city and wept over it, saying, “If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your eyes. For the days will come on you when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you, surround you, hem you in on every side, and will dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because you didn’t know the time of your visitation.”

“If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your eyes.

For the days will come on you when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you, surround you, hem you in on every side, and will dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because you didn’t know the time of your visitation.”

frase_es: no has conocido el tiempo en que Dios te ha visitado.
reflexion_es: Jesús llora porque no le dejamos traer su paz a nuestro corazón. Hoy pasa a tu lado y te visita: ¿sabrás reconocer su paso y acoger su amor en tu vida?
